records.title: Transformers and large language models are efficient feature extractors for electronic health record studies
records.reason: The primary full text studies BERT/GPT feature extraction on antibiotic-prescription EHR data and reports predictive F1; its use of efficient feature extraction is an application claim, not a model-side inference optimization.

records.title: FlightVGM: Efficient Video Generation Model Inference with Online Sparsification and Hybrid Precision on FPGAs
records.reason: The ACM publisher endpoint returned HTTP 403 and no author/institution primary copy was accessible; the abstract describes online activation sparsification and hybrid-precision FPGA VGM inference, but evidence is unavailable for full-text validation and transfer beyond video generation.

records.title: (Mis)Fitting: A Survey of Scaling Laws
records.reason: The survey reviews scaling-law methodology for foundation-model training decisions and reproducibility; it is linked to an inference-scaling paper but does not itself study inference-cost optimization in the reviewed text.

records.title: SDA: Low-Bit Stable Diffusion Acceleration on Edge FPGAs
records.reason: The institutional-author PDF describes W4A8 quantization, hybrid systolic execution of convolution and attention, DSP packing, and pipelined nonlinear operators; it reports comparable FID/CLIP, an 8x parameter-size reduction, and 97.3x speedup versus Cortex-A53 for Stable Diffusion. This is a concrete edge accelerator result, but its target is diffusion generation rather than LLM inference.
